**Purpose:** Self-contained reproduction of Figure 3 panels.
Extracted and reorganized from `02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd` (Panels B/C) and
`04_protein_de_go_analysis.Rmd` (Panels D/E).

**Panel A** is a workflow diagram created in Adobe Illustrator; no R code.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/wgcna_module_eigengenes.csv` — module eigengenes (from `extract_wgcna_tables.R`)
- `tables/wgcna_module_membership.csv` — protein-to-module assignments
- `tables/wgcna_module_membership_wide.csv` — wide-format module assignments
- `tables/master_tidy_protein.csv` — normalized protein expression
- WGCNA RData files in `output/wgcna/` (produced by `02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd`)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("figure3/Figure3.Rmd")`

**Note:** If WGCNA RData objects do not exist, run `02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd` first
(computationally intensive; ~30 min). Then run `extract_wgcna_tables.R` to export CSV
summaries used here.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(WGCNA)

out_dir  <- "figure3/plots"
data_dir <- "figure3/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
master <- read_csv("./tables/master_tidy_protein.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(normalized_ratio, normalized_intensity, ratio, intensity),
               names_to = "data", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(data = recode(data,
    "normalized_ratio"     = "normed_ratio",
    "normalized_intensity" = "normed_intensity"))

# WGCNA summary tables (produced by extract_wgcna_tables.R)
wgcna_me       <- tryCatch(read_csv("./tables/wgcna_module_eigengenes.csv",
                                     show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
wgcna_members  <- tryCatch(read_csv("./tables/wgcna_module_membership.csv",
                                     show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
wgcna_wide     <- tryCatch(read_csv("./tables/wgcna_module_membership_wide.csv",
                                     show_col_types = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)

if (is.null(wgcna_me)) {
  stop("WGCNA eigengene table not found.\n",
       "Run 02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd then extract_wgcna_tables.R first.")
}
```

## Panel B — WPM eigengene heatmap

One heatmap per WGCNA network (C×WT, C×rim15KO, P×WT, P×rim15KO). Each row is a
module eigengene (ME); columns are samples ordered by timepoint and replicate.

```{r panel-B}
# WGCNA networks were constructed per nutrient × genotype combination
networks <- c("C_WT", "C_rim15KO", "P_WT", "P_rim15KO")

ann_colors <- list(
  genotype = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
  nutrient = c("C" = "#ff9500",  "P"       = "#8300ab"),
  time     = c("T00" = "#fee8d0", "T06" = "#fdad60",
               "T16" = "#e85d04", "T30" = "#7f1900"),
  replicate = c("R1" = "#bae6c8", "R2" = "#44c76d", "R3" = "#016320"))

breaksList <- seq(-0.07, 0.07, by = 0.0001)

me_plots <- list()
for (net in networks) {
  nutri <- sub("_.*", "", net)
  gt    <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", net)

  rdata_path <- paste0("./output/wgcna/", nutri, "_", gt,
                        "_ratio_networkConstruction-auto.RData")
  if (!file.exists(rdata_path)) {
    message("Skipping ", net, ": RData not found at ", rdata_path)
    next
  }

  load(rdata_path)   # loads MEs, moduleLabels, moduleColors, geneTree

  annotation <- data.frame(rownames(MEs)) %>%
    separate(`rownames.MEs.`, c("nutrient", "genotype", "time", "replicate"))
  rownames(annotation) <- rownames(MEs)

  ph <- pheatmap(MEs,
           colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))(length(breaksList)),
           breaks           = breaksList,
           cluster_rows     = TRUE,
           cluster_cols     = FALSE,
           annotation_row   = annotation,
           annotation_colors = ann_colors,
           main             = paste0("Module eigengenes — ", net),
           fontsize         = 8,
           silent           = TRUE)
  pdf(file.path(out_dir, paste0("Fig3B_ME_", net, ".pdf")), width = 5, height = 6)
  grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)
  dev.off()
  grid::grid.draw(ph$gtable)   # render inline for HTML

  me_plots[[net]] <- MEs
}

# Source data export — eigengene matrix per network (combined)
all_me <- map_dfr(names(me_plots), function(net) {
  as.data.frame(me_plots[[net]]) %>%
    rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    mutate(network = net) %>%
    pivot_longer(-c(sample, network), names_to = "module", values_to = "eigengene")
})

write_csv(all_me, file.path(data_dir, "Fig3B_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig3B: eigengene data saved for ", length(me_plots), " networks")
```

## Panel C — WPM × variable Pearson correlation heatmap

Correlation between WGCNA module eigengenes and biological variables
(timepoint, genotype, nutrient) across all four networks.

```{r panel-C}
# Source: wgcna_module_eigengenes.csv (from extract_wgcna_tables.R)
# This table has columns: network, sample, ME[0..N], and metadata columns
# (nutrient, genotype, time, replicate).
if (!is.null(wgcna_me)) {
  # Expect columns: network, module, eigengene, sample + metadata
  # Build correlation: eigengene ~ time (numeric)
  me_wide <- wgcna_me %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = module, values_from = eigengene)

  # Numeric encoding of metadata variables
  meta_num <- me_wide %>%
    mutate(
      time_num     = as.integer(timepoint_h),
      genotype_num = as.integer(genotype == "WT"),
      nutrient_num = as.integer(nutrient == "C")) %>%
    dplyr::select(time_num, genotype_num, nutrient_num)

  me_values <- me_wide %>% dplyr::select(starts_with("ME"))

  if (ncol(me_values) > 0 && nrow(meta_num) > 3) {
    cor_mat <- cor(me_values, meta_num, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

    p_C <- pheatmap(
      cor_mat,
      colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(100),
      breaks        = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
      cluster_rows  = TRUE,
      cluster_cols  = FALSE,
      main          = "Module eigengene × variable Pearson correlation",
      fontsize      = 9,
      silent        = TRUE)

    pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3C_ME_variable_correlation.pdf"), width = 5, height = 7)
    grid::grid.draw(p_C$gtable)
    dev.off()
    grid::grid.draw(p_C$gtable)

    Fig3C_source <- as.data.frame(cor_mat) %>%
      rownames_to_column("module")
    write_csv(Fig3C_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig3C_source_data.csv"))
    message("Fig3C: correlation matrix saved")
  }
}
```

## Panel D — GO/KEGG enrichment dotplot per module

```{r panel-D}
# Enrichment results are stored in output/wgcna/ from 02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd
# If pre-generated CSV exists (from make_supplemental_tables.R), use that.
enrich_path <- "./tables/supplemental/S8_wgcna_module_membership.csv"

if (!is.null(wgcna_wide) && !is.null(wgcna_members)) {
  # Run GO enrichment for each module in each network
  # Note: this is computationally intensive; cache results when re-running.
  all_enrich <- list()

  for (net in unique(wgcna_members$network)) {
    net_members <- wgcna_members %>%
      dplyr::filter(network == net, !is.na(module), module != 0)

    for (mod in unique(net_members$module)) {
      mod_proteins <- net_members %>%
        dplyr::filter(module == mod) %>%
        pull(protein_id)

      ego <- tryCatch(
        clusterProfiler::enrichGO(
          gene          = mod_proteins,
          universe      = unique(wgcna_members$protein_id),
          ont           = "BP",
          keyType       = "UNIPROT",
          OrgDb         = "org.Sc.sgd.db",
          pAdjustMethod = "BH",
          qvalueCutoff  = 0.05),
        error = function(e) NULL)

      if (!is.null(ego) && nrow(ego@result) > 0) {
        all_enrich[[paste(net, mod, sep = "_")]] <- ego@result %>%
          mutate(network = net, module = mod)
      }
    }
  }

  if (length(all_enrich) > 0) {
    enrich_df <- bind_rows(all_enrich)

    p_D <- enrich_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(p.adjust < 0.05, Count > 2) %>%
      mutate(label = paste(network, "M", module)) %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = label, y = Description,
                 color = p.adjust, size = Count)) +
      geom_point() +
      scale_color_gradient(low = "#FF3333", high = "#3399FF",
                           name = "p.adjust") +
      xlab("Network — Module") +
      ylab("GO Biological Process") +
      theme_cowplot(font_size = 9) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
            axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7))

    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3D_GO_enrichment.pdf"),
           p_D, width = 12, height = 10, useDingbats = FALSE)
    p_D

    write_csv(enrich_df, file.path(data_dir, "Fig3D_source_data.csv"))
    message("Fig3D: ", nrow(enrich_df), " enrichment terms saved")
  }
}
```

## Panel E — Per-WPM expression distributions

Line plots of mean normalized protein expression per module over time, faceted by
nutrient and genotype.

```{r panel-E}
if (!is.null(wgcna_members)) {
  module_traj <- master %>%
    dplyr::filter(genotype != "spike-in", nutrient %in% c("C", "P")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(data == "normed_ratio") %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
    inner_join(wgcna_members %>%
                 dplyr::select(protein_id, network, module),
               by = c("Protein IDs" = "protein_id")) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(module), module != 0) %>%
    mutate(samplingTime = as.integer(sub("T", "", samplingTime)))

  module_summary <- module_traj %>%
    group_by(network, module, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime) %>%
    summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
              sem_val  = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups  = "drop") %>%
    mutate(module_label = paste0("M", module),
           genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15KO")))

  p_E <- ggplot(module_summary,
                aes(x = samplingTime, y = mean_val,
                    group = genotype, color = genotype)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - sem_val,
                    ymax = mean_val + sem_val,
                    fill = genotype),
                alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    facet_grid(module_label ~ nutrient + network, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                       labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
                      labels  = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 30)) +
    xlab("Hours post nutrient depletion") +
    ylab("Mean normalized ratio (± SEM)") +
    theme_cowplot(font_size = 8) +
    theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
          legend.title     = element_blank(),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text       = element_text(size = 7))

  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig3E_module_trajectories.pdf"),
         p_E, width = 14, height = max(6, n_distinct(module_summary$module_label) * 1.5),
         useDingbats = FALSE)
  p_E

  write_csv(module_summary, file.path(data_dir, "Fig3E_source_data.csv"))
  message("Fig3E: module trajectory data saved")
}
```
